text:
Samira K: Quick preflight — onboarding customer 'NovaHealth' hit quota + NAT IP limits during dry-run. Need to request: 6x A100 (a2), 2x H100, reserve 8 regional external NAT IPs for shared VPC in europe-west4, and a small L4 burst pool (12). Planning to use billing host infra-shared-eu. Any immediate blockers?
Ajay: Which project exactly? paste the project ID and tentative gcloud commands so I can start the quota ticket. Also confirm whether these are preemptible-only or need regular capacity.
Samira K: Project ID: novahealth-prod. Example gcloud snippet I'm going to include:```bash
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west4 --project novahealth-prod
gcloud compute project-info describe --project novahealth-prod
# For quota request (example)
# GPU quota: request for compute.googleapis.com/NVIDIA_A100_COUNT and NVIDIA_H100_COUNT
```
Marta: Heads-up — org policy in EU blocks external IPs by default for new projects. If they truly need static/external IPs we'll need an org-policy exception or route via Cloud NAT with reserved ranges. Which does the customer require?
Samira K: Pilot expects inbound callbacks (webhooks) from partner systems so they think they need static external IPs. We can probably do Cloud NAT with reserved IPs from infra-shared-eu to avoid org-policy exception. Decision pending.
Carlos: CostOps question — are we committing to dedicated H100s or is this burst/preemptible? H100s explode the cost if on-demand.
Samira K: Pilot preference is preemptible H100/A100 for week 1 to validate throughput. If stable, they'd talk reserved capacity. Request will specify preemptible preference and lower on-demand amounts.
infra-bot: Reminder: please attach the cost estimate and preferred start/end dates to the quota ticket. Use this template: https://rwd.internal/quota-template (automated message).
Ajay: I'll open the GCP quota ticket. Items I'll include: compute.googleapis.com/NVIDIA_A100_COUNT (region:europe-west4) = +6 (preemptible), compute.googleapis.com/NVIDIA_H100_COUNT = +2 (preemptible), compute.googleapis.com/REGIONAL_EXTERNAL_IPS = +8, compute.googleapis.com/TPU_V2_COUNT = 0 (N/A), and quota for CPUs/GPUs for the shared VPC host project.
Marta: Also include the host project (infra-shared-eu) and the service account that will use ps-connect / VPC peering: novahealth-gke-sa@novahealth-prod. We'll need IAM on the host project for the service account.
Samira K: Cost estimate quick calc: if everything on-demand H100 -> ~$18k/week. Preemptible A100 mix -> ~$3k/week. I'll attach a spreadsheet in the ticket. Start date requested: 2026-06-02 (pilot window).
CostOps: Please CC finance-ops@redwood.com and tag billing-host-admins. We need explicit sign-off for external IP spend > $500/month and for any cross-project NAT egress.
Carlos: One more risk — egress quota for europe-west4 could be tight for their dataset (high throughput). Can we bump regional network egress quota temporarily? Add region egress ceilings to the ticket.
Samira K: Good call — adding: networking.googleapis.com/REGIONAL_EXTERNAL_EGRESS_GB = +5TB/week (estimate).
Ajay: OK I'm filing the ticket now, will paste link. Please keep convo here for audit.
infra-bot: New quota ticket created: https://gcp-console.google.com/quotas/requests/QR-20260602-000123 (example). Ticket owner: Ajay.
Samira K: Thanks. I'll prep the org-policy exception backup plan in case static IPs are denied.
Marta: I'll standby to approve IAM changes on infra-shared-eu once ticket validated.
Carlos: Ping me if we need faster escalation to the cloud provider. Happy to take point. :thumbsup:
Samira K: Filed and linked the cost spreadsheet and Cloud NAT diagram in the ticket. Will update after finance sign-off.
CostOps: Noted — finance team looped in. We'll aim for 24h review.
Samira K: ETA update: if approvals come through, target provisioning 2026-06-03.
Ajay: Closing loop here when quotas are granted. Thanks everyone.
